filesToTouch.what: Pure ESM fixture module, zero IO / zero async / zero env reads (no priming, no mode switch). Data: const COUNTRIES = Object.freeze([...]) of exactly 253 entries { code, name }, transcribed from the legacy QA fixture ~/git/defra/ipaffs/ipaffs-qa-automation/types/country.ts (which holds exactly 253 entries and provably matches the rendered DOM labels — pages/country-of-origin.json evidence), with ONE deliberate override: IE is named 'Republic of Ireland', not country.ts's 'Ireland' (c-012 ruling: rendered-trace label wins). The 253 = 249 flat country entries (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes such as AF/AT/ZW, plus a small number of ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes the legacy list carries, e.g. ES-CN Canary Islands) + the 4 UK constituent nations GB-ENG=England, GB-SCT=Scotland, GB-WLS=Wales, GB-NIR=Northern Ireland. There is NO selectable 'GB' entry (legacy renders GB as a non-selectable optgroup label; country.ts has no UnitedKingdom key). Exports: (1) COUNTRIES (frozen array, source order = country.ts order); (2) UK_SUBDIVISION_CODES = Object.freeze(['GB-ENG', 'GB-SCT', 'GB-WLS', 'GB-NIR']); (3) REGION_FILTER_CODES = Object.freeze(['EEA', 'GB-CI', 'ROW']) — the dashboard country-filter pseudo-group codes (c-026; DOM-confirmed values, notifications-dashboard.json); (4) countryLabel(code) → name or undefined (lookup keyed by code — consuming pages store the CODE, never free text); (5) countryOptions() → frozen [{ value, text }] of the 249 non-UK-subdivision entries sorted alphabetically by text (govuk-select shape, matches the rendered flat list order); (6) ukSubdivisionOptions() → frozen [{ value, text }] of the 4 subdivisions in trace order England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland. NO display copy beyond country names (country names are reference data — L2 COUNTRY_LABELS precedent): the optgroup headings ('United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland', 'Countries', 'Country') and the EEA/GB-CI/ROW display labels are page copy owned by the consuming features' copy bundles (pp-018/pp-019/pp-036/pp-037), NOT this module. No labels for the region codes here. JSDoc per workspace doc-comments guide; no explanatory/migration comments.

Co-located Vitest unit test (runs under test:plant-products and npm test). Cases: (a) COUNTRIES has exactly 253 entries, all codes unique, every entry has non-empty string code and name; (b) no entry has code 'GB'; (c) countryLabel('IE') === 'Republic of Ireland' (c-012); (d) trace-verified label spot checks: AX='Aland Islands', AG='Antigua and Barbuda', BV='Bouvet Island', ES-CN='Canary Islands', VA='Holy See', TR='Turkey', US='United States of America', VN='Viet Nam', VI='Virgin Islands of the United States', AT='Austria', BZ='Belize'; (e) countryLabel of an unknown code is undefined; (f) countryOptions() has 249 entries, is alphabetical by text, every element is { value, text }, and contains no GB-* subdivision code and none of REGION_FILTER_CODES; (g) ukSubdivisionOptions() deep-equals [{value:'GB-ENG',text:'England'},{value:'GB-SCT',text:'Scotland'},{value:'GB-WLS',text:'Wales'},{value:'GB-NIR',text:'Northern Ireland'}]; (h) REGION_FILTER_CODES deep-equals ['EEA','GB-CI','ROW']; (i) COUNTRIES, UK_SUBDIVISION_CODES, REGION_FILTER_CODES and the two option arrays are frozen. Test on input/output only — no implementation-detail assertions.

notes: Rationale and rulings applied. (1) Entry count: MAPPING's '~254' counts the rendered select's 254 <option> elements = 1 'Select a country' placeholder + 253 selectable entries; the fixture holds the 253 selectable entries — the placeholder is page copy, owned by the consuming pages. Evidence: pages/country-of-origin.json optionsStructure (254 total = 1 placeholder + 249 flat + 4 in the single UK optgroup) with the count independently corroborated against ipaffs-qa-automation/types/country.ts (exactly 253 entries, no UnitedKingdom key). (2) c-012: displayed IE label is 'Republic of Ireland' (rendered trace) — country.ts says 'Ireland', so the transcription must apply this one override; tests select by value so legacy tests never see the divergence. (3) c-026: the dashboard's country filter is genuinely grouped in legacy source (three real optgroups: 'Countries' = All + EEA/GB-CI/ROW pseudo-options, 'Country' = the ISO countries, 'United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland' = the 4 nations); this fixture models the grouping EXPLICITLY AS DATA via three primitive exports (countryOptions / ukSubdivisionOptions / REGION_FILTER_CODES) and lets pp-037 compose the grouped control with labels from its copy bundle — decided here to keep display copy out of the service per the no-display-logic rule, matching how L2 services hold country names but no headings. (4) The journey-page UK optgroup question (raw <optgroup> is not a documented GOV.UK Select feature; page spec says 'decide with content design, do not copy by default') is pp-018's decision, not this increment's — the fixture is layout-neutral either way. (5) Also NOT ported: the legacy's regionOfOrigin side effect (GB-* selection persisting a separate partOne.commodities.regionOfOrigin) — a consuming-page/mapper concern recorded in the country-of-origin spec, out of scope for the fixture. (6) Exemplar: src/server/app/services/countries/stub.js + index.js for the label-map + options-array idiom; this module is simpler (no client.js, no prime, no mode). (7) Dep note: MAPPING's canonical dependsOn is only pp-007, but pp-010 (which adds the test:plant-products script) is m0 and will have landed by m1 build order; if it somehow has not, verification command 1 is unavailable and command 2 (npm test, which runs all of src/server/app including the plant set) is the covering check. (8) Run npm run format before commit (pre-commit hook enforces format + lint + units).
openQuestions: The full 253-entry transcription source is the local legacy clone ~/git/defra/ipaffs/ipaffs-qa-automation/types/country.ts (verified present 2026-07-31).
